# About Me

I am a **Research Statistician, Data Scientist, and Monitoring and
Evaluation specialist** with experience in applied research, survey
methodology, biostatistics, data management, statistical analysis,
stakeholder analysis, proposal development, and evidence generation.

My work focuses on using rigorous analytical approaches and data-driven
methods to generate evidence that supports research, programme
improvement, and decision-making. I have contributed to multidisciplinary
research projects spanning survey research, epidemiology, public health,
monitoring and evaluation, and programme assessment.

## Research & Analytical Experience

I have worked across multidisciplinary research teams, contributing to
the design, management, analysis, and reporting of research studies. My
experience includes working with survey and epidemiological data,
supporting data quality processes, conducting statistical analyses,
developing analytical outputs, contributing to scientific manuscripts,
and supporting research dissemination.

My project experience includes multi-country HPV vaccination research,
integrated serosurveillance in Kenya, and political economy and
value-for-money analysis of HIV prevention and service delivery
programmes.


## Approach to Data and Research

I am particularly interested in connecting sound statistical methods
with practical research and programme questions. I value analytical
rigour, reproducibility, clear communication, and the responsible use
of data to generate evidence that can inform decisions.

I am also interested in the growing role of data science and artificial
intelligence in research and evidence generation, particularly where
these technologies can improve efficiency, strengthen analytical
workflows, and make complex information more accessible.
